last_action: Added a Conway's Game of Life cellular-automaton sandbox (/life.html): click/drag to draw on a toroidal grid, load classic patterns (glider, spaceship, pulsar, Gosper gun, pentadecathlon, acorn), set speed, and run the simulation. The board is encoded in the URL hash so any state is shareable/restorable. Fully client-side, no backend. Wired into the nav, sitemap, selftest, Work list, and API manifest; bumped SITE_VERSION to 3.6.
note: heartbeat_epoch/generated_epoch are filled in at deploy/heartbeat time.
